rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: NVIDIAと、AIインフラ向けの先端レーザーと光ネットワーク製品の複数年の供給契約を締結
relations.text_en: Entered a strategic multi-year supply agreement with NVIDIA for advanced lasers and optical networking products supporting next-generation AI infrastructure

source.label: Coherent 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: entered into a strategic multi-year supply agreement with NVIDIA for advanced lasers and optical networking products supporting next-generation AI infrastructure

relations.text: NVIDIAと複数年・非独占の戦略契約を結び、数十億ドル規模のNVIDIAの購入コミットメントと、先端技術の今後の利用・生産枠の権利を含む
relations.text_en: NVIDIA entered a multi-year, non-exclusive strategic agreement with Coherent that includes a multi-billion-dollar NVIDIA purchase commitment and future access and capacity rights for advanced technologies

source.label: Coherent 8-K Exhibit 99.1 の発表(2026年3月2日)
source.quote: The non-exclusive agreement includes an NVIDIA multi-billion-dollar purchase commitment and future access and capacity rights for advanced laser and optical networking products.

relations.text: NVIDIAが、2026年3月2日に新規発行のCoherent普通株7,788,161株を20億ドルの現金で私募により取得
relations.text_en: NVIDIA bought 7,788,161 newly issued Coherent common shares for $2B in cash in a private placement on March 2, 2026

source.label: Coherent 8-K(2026年3月2日)
source.quote: Coherent completed the issuance and sale of 7,788,161 shares of the Company’s common stock, no par value (the “Shares”), pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, at a price of $256.80 per share for an aggregate purchase price of $2 billion in cash.

relations.text: Appleが、Face IDなどに使うVCSELレーザーを作る長年のパートナーCoherentと、新たな複数年契約を締結
relations.text_en: Apple entered a new multiyear agreement with Coherent, a long-standing partner that produces the VCSEL lasers used for features including Face ID

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム(2025年8月6日)
source.quote: Apple has also entered into a new multiyear agreement with Coherent, a long-standing partner that produces the VCSEL lasers that enable multiple features — including Face ID

relations.text: DENSOが、Coherent子会社Silicon Carbide LLCのクラスA普通ユニットに5億ドルを出資
relations.text_en: Denso invested $500M in Coherent’s Silicon Carbide LLC subsidiary for Class A Common Units (about 12.5% ownership)

source.label: Coherent 10-K(2026年度), 注記15
source.quote: Silicon Carbide LLC (“Silicon Carbide”), one of the Company’s subsidiaries, completed (i) the sale of 16,666,667 Class A Common Units to Denso Corporation (“Denso”) for $ 500,000,000
source.note: 出資先は子会社のSilicon Carbide LLCで、取引は2023年12月に完了しています。
source.note_en: A subsidiary-level investment (Silicon Carbide LLC); the transaction closed in December 2023.

relations.text: 三菱電機が、Coherent子会社Silicon Carbide LLCのクラスA普通ユニットに5億ドルを出資
relations.text_en: Mitsubishi Electric (MELCO) invested $500M in Coherent’s Silicon Carbide LLC subsidiary for Class A Common Units (about 12.5% ownership)

source.label: Coherent 10-K(2026年度), 注記15
source.quote: the sale of 16,666,667 Class A Common Units to Mitsubishi Electric Corporation (“MELCO”) for $ 500,000,000
source.note: 出資先は子会社のSilicon Carbide LLCで、取引は2023年12月に完了しています。
source.note_en: A subsidiary-level investment (Silicon Carbide LLC); the transaction closed in December 2023.

relations.text: IPGは材料加工で、レーザーメーカーの1社「Coherent, Inc.」と競合する
relations.text_en: IPG Photonics competes with laser makers such as Coherent, Inc. in materials processing.

source.label: IPG Photonics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we compete with makers of fiber lasers and other lasers, such as Coherent, Inc.,
source.note: 資料の名前は、のちにCoherent Corp.(旧II-VI)が2022年に買収した旧Coherent, Inc.です。
source.note_en: The filing names the legacy Coherent, Inc., later acquired by Coherent Corp. (formerly II-VI).

relations.text: nLIGHTと競合する半導体レーザー・ファイバーレーザー企業の1社がCoherentだ
relations.text_en: Coherent is among the companies offering semiconductor lasers, fiber lasers and other laser products that compete with nLIGHT.

source.label: nLIGHT 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: such as IPG Photonics, Coherent, BWT Ltd.,
source.note: 資料には「Coherent」とだけあり、Coherent Corp.を指すと解釈しています。
source.note_en: The filing says only “Coherent”; it is read as Coherent Corp.

relations.text: Coherent CorporationはAAOIの主要な競合の1社に当たる
relations.text_en: Coherent Corporation is one of Applied Optoelectronics' major competitors.

source.label: Applied Optoelectronics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our major competitors in one or more of our markets include Coherent Corporation,

relations.text: Coherent Corp.の製品は、MKSのレーザー・フォトニクス製品と競合関係にある
relations.text_en: Coherent Corp. offers products that compete with MKS's laser and photonics products

source.label: MKS Instruments 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Coherent Corp., Excelitas Technologies Corp., Jenoptik AG and Thorlabs, Inc. offer products that compete with our laser and photonics products.

relations.text: Coherentは、Viaviの光セキュリティ・性能事業で競合する受動部品などのメーカーの1社だ
relations.text_en: Coherent is one of the manufacturers of passive and other optical components that compete with Viavi's optical security and performance business.

source.label: Viavi Solutions 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: manufacturers of passive and other optical components such as Coherent.
source.note: 資料には「Coherent」とだけあり、Coherent Corp.を指すと解釈しています。
source.note_en: The filing says only “Coherent”; it is read as Coherent Corp.

relations.text: Fabrinetのカスタム光学・ガラス事業は、Coherent傘下のPhotop Technologiesと競合する
relations.text_en: Fabrinet's customized optics and glass operations compete with Photop Technologies, a subsidiary of Coherent Corp.

source.label: Fabrinet 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Photop Technologies, Inc. (a subsidiary of Coherent Corp.).
source.note: Fabrinetの光学・ガラス事業での、子会社Photopとの競合です。
source.note_en: Subsidiary-level competition (Photop) in Fabrinet’s optics and glass operations only.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
